chunks: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

Indeed, God — Mighty and Majestic — created us and made our creation excellent; He formed us and made our forms excellent; He made us His treasurers in His heaven and in His earth; for us the tree spoke; by our worship, God — Mighty and Majestic — is worshipped; and were it not for us, God would not be worshipped.

key_terms.خُزَّانَ: treasurers/guardians — a title denoting the Imams as custodians of God's knowledge and secrets
key_terms.عُبِدَ اللَّهُ: God is worshipped — the passive construction emphasizing that true worship of God is mediated through the Imams
key_terms.نَطَقَتِ الشَّجَرَةُ: the tree spoke — alluding to the Quranic account of the burning bush from which God spoke to Moses, and similar miraculous speech in Islamic tradition

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the role of the Imams as God's treasurers and intermediaries of worship?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) articulates the cosmic and mediatory role of the Imams of Ahl al-Bayt in this declaration: God created them with special excellence, appointed them as His guardians of divine knowledge in both the heavens and the earth, and — in the most exalted claim — that God is only worshipped through their mediation. The reference to the tree speaking 'for us' alludes to the miraculous tree that spoke to Moses at Sinai (a symbol of divine guidance through chosen intermediaries) and parallels in the Prophet's tradition. Historically, this statement was made in a context where the Shia community needed theological grounding for the special status of the Imams as bearers of divine knowledge and as the indispensable link between humanity and God.
word_analysis: and were it not for us

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Musa Bin Al Qasim Bin Muawiya and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Al Amraky Bin Ali, altogether, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘

Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Created us<sup>asws</sup>, so excellent are our<sup>asws</sup> creations, and Imaged us<sup>asws</sup>, so excellent are our<sup>asws</sup> images, and Made us<sup>asws</sup> to be His<sup>azwj</sup> treasurers in His<sup>azwj</sup> sky and in His<sup>azwj</sup> earth, and for us<sup>asws</sup> the trees spoke, and by our<sup>asws</sup> worship, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is worshipped, and had it not been for us<sup>asws</sup>, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would not be worshipped’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Musa ibn al-Qasim ibn Mu‘awiya and Muhammad ibn Yahya from al-‘Amrakiy ibn Ali altogether from Ali ibn Ja’far from abu al-Hassan Musa (a.s.) who has said the following. “Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) has said, ‘

Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, created us and He made our creation the best. He formed us and made our the best. He made us the treasurers of in His heavens and His earth. For us the tree spoke and with our worship Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, is worshipped. Had we not been in existence Allah would have been worshipped.”
